text:
Maya R.: FYI support saw two customers hit an opaque 413 from the embed fastpath splitter today. no hints, lots of back-and-forth.
Jessica L.: propose structured 413 body: `{"code":"embed_oversize", "reason":"mixed_dims_or_bytes", "hint": "call /v1/embeddings/preflight or enable X-Embed-AutoSplit"}`
Arun P.: runtime note  we can fallback to slowpath but clients that fast-fail get immediate 413. options: default fallback or client-side preflight.
Ryan H.: SDK plan: on 413 + embed_oversize -> call POST /v1/embeddings/preflight, apply returned split plan, retry. add opt-in header `X-Embed-AutoSplit: true`. will emit `embed.preflight.retry` metric.
Sam K.: console: surface a small "Resolve 413" card on route pages when 413 rate spikes. show suggested split, sample curl, and a one-click preflight modal. Grafana suggestion: `sum(rate(embed_requests_total{status="413"}[5m])) by (route)` and `413 / total` ratio with drilldown to `embed.fastpath.reject_reason`.
deploy-bot: canary deploy `embed-splitter:v2` -> us-west-2 (20%).
Maya R.: owners/timeline: Ryan -> SDK PR + tests this week; Jessica+Arun -> spec + docs; Sam -> console mock by Fri. sync tomorrow 11am to close. :thumbsup:
